'''HASH-19''' was an [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] who was operating in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Appearing similar to a surveillance [[AC1 surveillance droid|spy-eye]], HASH-19 was a gold-chrome metallic ball. However, when provoked, six extensible arms were revealed, each armed with [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]]. Employed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Bandor (Moff)|Bandor]], he was sent to patrol the [[Game Chambers]] of [[Questal/Legends|Questal]].
